በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ወርእዮ: ርእየ — and he saw him (ወ- + 3m sg perfect + -o, r-ʾ-y)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ደንገፀ: ደንገፀ — he was startled (3ms perfect, d-n-g-ḍ)
ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')

ወአንሥኦ: አንሥአ — and he raised him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, n-ś-ʾ + -ኦ 'him'; subject not stated) · or here perhaps ወ- + infinitive አንሥኦ 'and to lift up', before ኵናቶ (?)
እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return')
ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
ምንባሪሃ: መንበር — her place of setting, her seat (noun, variant spelling ምንባር of መንበር, as in published ch. 29, + -ሃ '3fs her')
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
ወወድቀ: ወድቀ — and he fell (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-d-q)
ወወደየ: ወደየ — and he put, placed (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, w-d-y)
ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
ለቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ለ- + noun, construct)
ወአዘዘ: አዘዘ — and he commanded (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
ለወልዱ: ወልድ — to his son (ለ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ለኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — to all of them, all of them (ለ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp'; the ለ- marks the object)
በአፈ: አፍ — by the mouth of (በ- + noun, construct አፈ)
ኀጺን: ኀጺን — iron (noun; በአፈ ኀጺን 'by the edge of iron', i.e. the sword)
በአፉሁ: አፍ — with his mouth (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ወፈቀዱ: ፈቀደ — and they wished (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
ማኅደረ: ማኅደር — dwelling-place (construct) · accusative 'a lodging' (ወወሀባ ማኅደረ 'and he gave her a lodging')
ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential)
ሕገ: ሕግ — law (accusative) · construct 'law of' (ሕገ መንግሥት 'the law of kingship')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam')
ተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — he arose, rose up (3m sg perfect, n-s-ʾ)
ተናገረ: ተናገረ — he spoke, conversed (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነገረ)
ተንሥኡ: ተንሥአ — rise! (2mp imperative, Gt) · they arose (3mp perfect)
ተጋብኡ: ተጋብአ — gather, assemble (3mp perfect, T stem)
አቤራት: አቤር — women, wives (plural አቤራት; lemma and meaning inferred from parallel with ደናግል) (?)
ተነሥአት: ተንሥአ — she rose (3fs perfect, n-ś-ʾ; subject ጽዮን)
እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ገብአ: ገብአ — he returned (3ms perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
ይምነ: የማን — right, right side (noun, here adverbial 'to the right'; spelled ይምነ)
ወፅግመ: ፅግም — and left side (ወ- + noun, adverbial accusative 'to the left')
እመቦ: እመ — if there is (እመ + ቦ 'there is')
መባርዲን: መባርዲን — couriers, mounted messengers (plural in -ን; singular not identified); word unidentified, perhaps from barīd 'post' (?)
ወሖሩ: ሖረ — and they went (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
ወበጽሑ: በጽሐ — and they arrived (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city')
ወተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
ሐራ: ሐራ — soldiers, army, host (noun, collective; ሊቀ ሐራ 'chief of soldiers')
ወይቤልዎሙ: ብህለ — and they said to them (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎሙ 'to them')
ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct)
እምርሑቅ: ርሑቅ — from afar (እም- + adjective used as noun 'distance')
በዝየ: ዝየ — here (በ- + adverb ዝየ 'here'; the በ- adds nothing to the sense)
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people')
ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
ገብኡ: ገብአ — they returned (3mp perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
ወነገርዎ: ነገረ — and they told him (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, G + -ዎ 3ms object)
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun) · marking the object, doubled by a suffix on the verb (ይሕምይዎ ለንጉሥ 'they revile the king') or by a suffix on a noun (ሐሚዮቱ ለንጉሥ 'the reviling of the king')
እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you')
ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea') · accusative object or goal: 'reached the sea' (ወበጽሑ ባሕረ), 'crossed the sea' (ዐደዉ ባሕረ), 'came out of the sea' (ወወፅኡ ባሕረ), ch. 55
ኢርትራ: ኢርትራ — Erythraean, Red (Greek-derived; ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'the Red Sea') (proper name)
ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
በጻሕነ: በጽሐ — we have arrived (1cp perfect, b-ṣ-ḥ)
ኀቤከ: ኀበ — at, with, to (preposition, form ኀቤ- + -ከ 'you', 2ms)
መጠነ: መጠን — measure; መጠነ 'as far as, according to the measure of' (construct as conjunction/preposition)
ሐዊረ: ሐዊር — going (verbal noun of ሖረ, accusative; 'to go')
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ኀለፈ: ኀለፈ — he/it passed away (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-l-f)
አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father')
ጸዐኑ: ጸዐነ — they loaded (3mp perfect, G, as ወጸዐኑ in ch. 51–52); 'mounted' is possible (?)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ዘየሐውር: ሖረ — which goes, travels (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
መልዕልተ: መልዕልት — surface, upper part; upon (noun, construct, used as preposition) · above, on high, opposed to መትሕተ 'below' (ወትከውን መልዕልተ 'and you will be above')
ነፉስ: ነፋስ — wind (noun; spelled ነፉስ) · ነፉስ in በሰረገላ ነፉስ perhaps 'of wind, airy' (?)

ወለነሰ: ለ — and as for us (ወ- + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us' + contrastive -ሰ)
በጥበብከ: ጥበብ — in your wisdom (በ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
ቦኑ: ቦ — is there? is it so that? (existential ቦ + interrogative -ኑ)
ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
